Advance Your Research and Shape Your Field
Graduate Programs
Our graduate programs combine rigorous training with collaborative research opportunities across departments and disciplines. Work alongside leading faculty on groundbreaking projects and mentor undergraduates—all while building the skills and connections that will define your career.
Join Our Community of Scholars
Apply to a Graduate Program
Applications for our Ph.D. and master's programs are processed through Vanderbilt's Graduate School. All new students enroll in the fall, with applications opening each August for the following year.
Learn About Graduate Admissions
Our Graduate Programs
Graduate education in the College of Arts and Science focuses on doctoral programs, with students typically earning the M.A. or M.S. in progress toward the Ph.D. We also offer several terminal master's degrees, as noted below.

Graduate Certificates
Add depth or breadth to your doctoral studies with a graduate certificate. These programs help you strengthen your application for the workforce and connect your research to complementary fields.
Graduate Certificate Program in African American and Diaspora Studies
Graduate Certificate Program in Asian Studies
Graduate Certificate Program in Gender and Sexuality Studies
Graduate Certificate Program in Jewish Studies
Graduate Certificate Program in Medicine, Health, and Society
Graduate Certificate Program in Multimessenger Astronomy
Graduate Certificate in Museum and Market Studies
4+1 Program: Earn Two Degrees in Five Years
Current Arts and Science undergraduates can earn both a bachelor's and master's degree in just five years through our 4+1 program. Save time and money while gaining advanced expertise in your field.
Learn about the 4+1 Program
Research Opportunities
Graduate students in Arts and Science conduct cutting-edge research across disciplines at the center of a world-class research university. You'll collaborate with faculty on groundbreaking projects and contribute to research that advances knowledge and solves real-world problems.
Explore Graduate Student Research
Meet Our Graduate Students
Read More Stories
Our graduate students come from across the United States and around the world, creating a dynamic and diverse learning community. They conduct groundbreaking research, teach undergraduates, and build the foundations for successful careers in academia, industry, government, and beyond.
